title: Craftable villagers spawn egg
description: This datapack add craft for villager spawn egg
body:
This Datapack craft villager spawn egg for minecraft in survival 1.21.7-1.21.8
This data pack is ideal if you've run out of villagers in your village and need more, or if you've found emeralds, for example, in a ship and can now craft villagers.

For craft you need 1 iron axe, 1 iron pickaxe, 1 iron shovel, 1 fletching table, 1 smoker,
1 composter, 1 emerald block and 2 bookshelf
